title: VTA Credentials — List
description: Enumerate the credentials an agent has issued, as metadata. Every filter is optional and those present are AND-combined.

holder.description: Only credentials issued to this DID.

credentialType.description: Only credentials carrying this type tag beyond `VerifiableCredential`.

status.description: Only credentials in this state. Derived by the agent at read time, never stored.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue. Opaque — consumers must not construct or parse one.

limit.description: The most records to return; the responder chooses a default and MAY return fewer. The agent caps this value.

credentials.description: One summary per matching credential. Empty when nothing matched — a successful answer, not an error.

nextCursor.description: Pass to the next request as `cursor` to continue. Present when more matching credentials remain; absent when the page is the last. A consumer must not read a page that carries a `nextCursor` as a complete account of what was issued.

IssuedCredentialSummary.title: IssuedCredentialSummary
IssuedCredentialSummary.description: A body-free projection of an issuance record. Carries no claim content by construction — see the specification's rationale for why a list does not return credentials.

holder.description: Who the credential was issued to.

credentialType.description: The type tag beyond `VerifiableCredential`, when the credential carries one.

revocationReason.description: Free text recorded at revocation. Disclosed to every caller entitled to this list — see Security & Privacy.

IssuedCredentialStatus.description: Derived at read time. `revoked` takes precedence over `expired`: a credential revoked before its window closed is revoked, and reporting it as merely expired would hide that somebody acted.
